spec.title: Historic Marrakech in One Day
spec.description: Explore Marrakech's essential historical monuments on a one-day walking route through the Medina, from its Almoravid origins and Almohad landmarks to the palaces and royal monuments of the Saadian and Alaouite periods.

steps.title: Start at Madrasa Ben Youssef
steps.description: Begin the morning in the historic heart of the Medina at Madrasa Ben Youssef . Explore its central courtyard, student rooms, carved cedar, stucco decoration and zellige craftsmanship.

steps.title: Discover the Almoravid Koubba
steps.description: Walk to the nearby Almoravid Koubba, one of the rare surviving monuments from the Almoravid period and an important link to the origins of Marrakech.

steps.title: Walk Through the Historic Souks
steps.description: Continue south through the Medina's traditional souks. Observe workshops, narrow streets, fondouks and traditional commercial life while heading toward Jemaa el-Fna.

steps.title: Arrive at Jemaa el-Fnaa Square
steps.description: Reach Marrakech's historic central square. Use the morning visit to understand its position between the souks, Koutoubia and the southern Medina before returning later when the square becomes more animated.

steps.title: Visit the Koutoubia Mosque
steps.description: Walk to Marrakech's most recognizable monument. Admire the 12th-century Almohad minaret and explore the surrounding gardens and exterior of the mosque.

steps.title: Pass Through Bab Agnaou
steps.description: Continue toward the Kasbah and stop at Bab Agnaou, the monumental Almohad gateway that historically provided ceremonial access to Marrakech's royal Kasbah.

steps.title: Explore the Saadian Tombs
steps.description: Visit the royal necropolis of the Saadian dynasty. Explore the decorated mausoleums, gardens and the celebrated Chamber of the Twelve Columns.

steps.title: Lunch in the Kasbah
steps.description: Take a lunch break around the Kasbah before continuing to the palaces of southern Marrakech.

steps.title: Explore El Badi Palace
steps.description: Explore the monumental ruins of the palace commissioned by Saadian Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur. Walk through its vast courtyard, sunken gardens and surviving structures while learning about the power of Saadian Marrakech.

steps.title: Visit Bahia Palace
steps.description: Continue to Bahia Palace, a major example of 19th-century Moroccan palace architecture. Explore its courtyards, gardens, painted cedar ceilings, carved plaster and richly decorated reception rooms.

steps.title: Return Through the Medina
steps.description: Walk north through the Medina toward Jemaa el-Fna, passing traditional streets and shops as the atmosphere changes toward the evening.

steps.title: End the Day at Jemaa el-Fna
steps.description: Finish the historical route at Jemaa el-Fna in the late afternoon or evening, when food stalls, performers and crowds transform the historic square into one of Marrakech's defining cultural experiences.
